notes.title: Simplified Chinese Update!
notes.notes:
The Hex Hanslation Group has done it again! After delivering an expert translation for The Hex earlier this year, they have been hard at work on Pony Island. Once again they have outdone themselves - I think some of details of this localization will be a delight for Chinese speaking players.

The team includes: YazawaAkiOS, LemonBomb, evilmoth, Lil_Catt, mushr00m, AlerHughes, and 8012white

Once again Yazawa Akio has graced us with the beautiful cover art for the patch:

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/10418521/4530c0ae8835c2410383df37d9fe7c6c6c871430.png

Unexpectedly, Yazawa Akio went further this time and even created a Pony Island Binding of Isaac Mod????? The mod was coded by PixelPlz.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/10418521/de049c4824d5c76b067c74f6c18c3771bc99edab.gif

Thanks once again to everyone who enabled my indie career by playing Pony Island 

And keep an eye out for Pony Island 2: Panda Circus!

notes.title: v1.16 patch notes
notes.notes:
Hey guys, just another little patch here:

     Allow re-mappable keys for the 'Jump' and 'Laser' actions. The default is Spacebar for 'Laser' and Right Alt for 'Jump'
     Do not allow player to [spoiler] actually clear their save data if they select 'Clear Save Data' after clicking on the 'PonyIsland.META' shortcut in the Recycling Bin. [/spoiler]

notes.title: v1.15 some more minor bug fixes
notes.notes:
If you find all 24 tickets in your first run [spoiler]you will not be taken to the 'final ending' until you actually complete the game.[/spoiler]
     Fixed [spoiler]Uber-satan death animation[/spoiler]
     Fixed audio from game sometimes continuing to play into the main menu
     Numeric button remapping now properly tells you to use 'Option' to open the dialog on OSX
     If you're a smarty-pants and [spoiler]enter Hopeless Soul's password into his profile before he tells it to you, he might try to expedite your playthrough[/spoiler]

notes.title: Version 1.13 live! OST metadata, AZERTY keyboard fix and...
notes.notes:
Hey Pony Island players, here's the next update:


     To fix an issue where players with non-QWERTY keyboards could not enter numbers 1-9, I have added the ability to remap these keys. If you hold shift while launching the game, a launcher will appear to change these settings.
     The original soundtrack .mp3 files now have proper metadata with the artist's (Jonah Senzel's) name and a nice looking album art image.
     Lucifer is actually an OK guy. He just hit refresh on his Code Storage.

notes.title: Hotfix for lasers issue (v1.12)
notes.notes:
Nothing exciting:

There was an issue after the patch allowing the spacebar to fire lasers in which [spoiler]the code puzzle portal at the beginning of 'Adventure Mode' would only open with a right mouse click and not a spacebar press.[/spoiler] To those who had used the spacebar from the beginning, this prevented them from proceeding.

notes.title: V1.11 live! Bug fixes and rewards for masochism!
notes.notes:
Thanks again to everyone who reports their issues in the discussion forums.

The changes for this patch are...

     Fix for issues with [spoiler]Pony Wings[/spoiler] at low FPS. For those with lower-end hardware, you should be able to get through these levels now.
     Fix for getting stuck on the first [spoiler]'Surrender Your Soul'[/spoiler] screen after saving and loading.
     Fixed bug caused by click-spamming the start button at [spoiler]Satantech Keep[/spoiler]
     And finally... because some players are crazy enough to ACTUALLY [spoiler]grind out 100XP in Act II when Lucifer tells them to, instead of hacking the XP bar... the wings will now actually unlock when this is done.[/spoiler] Please... don't do this to yourself.

notes.title: Version 1.10 now live! Includes community requests
notes.notes:
The time I had to work on the game today was spent adding in some small but requested features from the discussion forums. These include:


     Support for 1440p resolution.
     Adding the spacebar as an alternative input for shooting your pony lasers. This is to aid people who find the double mouse button setup uncomfortable or who have a one-button mouse.
     Added a couple new 'Act Select' shortcut buttons to the main menu. This should make the hunt for all 24 tickets less repetitive :)

notes.title: Day 2 Patch (v1.08) is live! Just some bug fixes.
notes.notes:
Whew! What an amazing reaction to the game. I had some people report bugs in the discussion forums yesterday and I'm happy to say most of them are fixed.

The changes are as follows:

     Fixed a major bug: if you were stuck after the [spoiler]"Pony Island's of old" section because you quit the game while Hopeless Soul was talking to you,"[/spoiler] you should be able to continue from where you left off now!
     Fixed buggy audio when quitting the game during the tutorial levels of Act III and then reloading
     Fixed sometimes-broken code puzzles that force you to quit to the main menu and return to continue
     Fixed bug caused by [spoiler]entering nothing as a name when Hopeless Soul asks for your name[/spoiler]
     Fixed some typos in the credits
     ... Satan has updated his 'code storage' screen
